blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to interpret, generate, and mediate public-facing language, which makes their reliability especially consequential in politically sensitive settings. Although sentiment analysis is a common task in this area, affective meaning in social media discourse is often conveyed through culturally situated and pragmatically indirect cues that are not well captured by label-centric evaluation alone. In this paper, we evaluate the robustness of LLMs for sentiment analysis of Spanish political discourse from social media, with emphasis on culturally situated affective interpretation. We introduce a diagnostic protocol that combines three independent human annotation views into Gold and Ambiguous subsets, and extends the corpus with a Synthetic subset built from sentiment-flipped counterfactuals selected through model-conditioned perplexity and LLM-as-a-judge criteria. Using this framework, we compare proprietary and open-weight models under zero-shot and few-shot prompting, focusing on predictive robustness across human agreement conditions and counterfactual shift. Our results show that annotation ambiguity and counterfactual perturbation reveal failure modes that conventional evaluation on the original corpus tends to obscure. GPT-4.1-mini remains the most stable among the evaluated models, whereas the two smaller open-weight models degrade more markedly under synthetic perturbations, and few-shot prompting provides only limited gains. Overall, the paper contributes a reproducible protocol for robustness-oriented evaluation in political sentiment analysis, an empirical characterization of model behavior under ambiguity and sentiment-flipped counterfactuals, and a publicly available Spanish social media dataset with three-way human sentiment annotations.
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)被越来越多地用于解释,生成和调解公用语言,这使得其可靠性在政治敏感环境下尤其具有后果. 虽然情绪分析是该领域的一项共同任务,但社交媒体言论中的感人意义往往通过文化定位和务实的间接提示传递,而仅靠以标签为中心的评价并不能很好地抓住这些提示。 在本文中,我们评价LLMs在社交媒体上对西班牙政治言论进行情绪分析的力度,强调文化位置的感人解释. 我们引入了一种诊断协议,将三种独立的人类注释观点结合到Gold和Ambigious子集中,并用一个合成子集来扩展本体,这个子集由情感浮出反事实组成,通过模型-条件的迷惑和LLM-as-a-judged等标准来选择. 利用这个框架,我们比较了零发和几发催化下的专有和开口量模型,重点是人类协议条件的预测强度和反事实转变。 我们的结果显示,注释模糊和反事实扰动揭示了对原始内容的传统评价往往模糊不清的失败模式。 GPT-4.1-mini仍然是受评价模型中最稳定的,而两个较小的开放重量模型在合成扰动下降解得更明显,而少发快发只带来有限的收益. 总的来说,该文件为政治情绪分析中以稳健性为导向的评价提供了可复制的协议,为模范行为在模棱两可和情绪浮出水面的反事实下提供了经验性定性,并为西班牙社交媒体提供了一套可公开查阅的、带有 " 三向 " 人类情绪说明的数据集。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Large language models (LLMs) have rapidly become foundational components of contemporary language technologies, supporting tasks such as classification, summarization, explanation generation, content moderation, retrieval support, and synthetic text production [ 1 ] . As their deployment expands across education, industry, and public-sector workflows, so does their capacity to shape how information is produced, interpreted, and circulated. This is particularly consequential in democratic contexts, where language is not merely a medium of communication but a core mechanism of participation, deliberation, and accountability [ 2 ] . In this sense, LLMs may strengthen the public sphere by improving access to information, facilitating citizen-government interaction, supporting civic engagement, and helping identify citizen-reported issues from large-scale social media data [ 3 , 4 ] . At the same time, their generative and persuasive capabilities create new risks, including the large-scale production of convincing political content, the simulation of citizen-like discourse, and the amplification of misinformation or disinformation narratives that may affect public trust and democratic representation [ 5 , 6 , 7 ] .
blocks.zh: 大型语言模型(LLMs)已迅速成为当代语言技术的基础成分,支持诸如分类,归纳,解释生成,内容节制,检索支持,和合成文本制作等任务[1]. 随着它们的部署跨越教育、工业和公共部门的工作流程,它们确定如何编制、解释和传播信息的能力也在扩大。 在民主背景下,这种情况尤其严重,因为语言不仅仅是一种交流媒介,而且是参与、审议和问责制的核心机制[2]。 从这个意义上讲,地方政府可以加强公共领域,改善信息的获取,促进公民与政府的互动,支持公民参与,并帮助从大型社交媒体数据中找出公民报告的问题[3、4]。 同时,他们的基因和说服能力也带来了新的风险,包括大规模制作令人信服的政治内容,模拟类似公民的言论,以及扩大可能影响到公众信任和民主代表性的虚假或虚假叙述[5、6、7]。

blocks.en: Affective signals are central to this problem because political communication often seeks not only to inform, but also to mobilize, persuade, polarize, or delegitimize actors and institutions. Within natural language processing (NLP), sentiment analysis is a long-standing task for identifying opinions, affective orientation, and evaluative stance in text, and it has been widely used to summarize large volumes of user-generated content [ 8 ] . In political and participatory settings, these methods can support the analysis of online discussions, public concerns, and deliberative processes [ 9 ] . Prior work has also advanced sentiment analysis for Spanish social media in electoral contexts, showing the relevance of annotated corpora and LLM-based evaluation for politically charged discourse [ 10 , 11 ] . However, political sentiment in social media is rarely reducible to stable labels or surface polarity. Its interpretation often depends on tone, irony, emojis, hashtags, local references, and culturally shared pragmatic cues. Thus, strong performance under standard metrics may conceal deeper interpretive limitations, especially when models face ambiguous or culturally situated language. This aligns with recent arguments that evaluating generative AI should be treated as a measurement challenge, where the target construct and the validity of the evaluation instrument must be explicitly examined [ 12 , 13 ] .
blocks.zh: 情感信号是这一问题的核心,因为政治沟通往往不仅寻求提供信息,而且寻求动员、说服、分化或使行为者和机构失去合法性。 在自然语言处理(NLP)中,情绪分析是确定意见,情感取向,以及文本中评价立场的长期任务,被广泛用于总结大量用户生成的内容 [8]. 在政治和参与环境中,这些方法可以支持对在线讨论、公众关切和审议过程的分析[9]。 先前的工作还推进了对西班牙社交媒体在选举背景下的情绪分析,显示了附加说明的Corpora和基于LLM的评价对政治指控的言论的相关性[10,11]. 然而,社交媒体上的政治情绪很少被降低到稳定的标签或表面极性. 它的解释往往取决于语气、讽刺、情感、标签、地方参考资料和文化上共享的务实提示。 因此,在标准衡量标准下的有力表现可能掩盖更深刻的解释性限制,特别是当模型面临模棱两可或文化背景的语言时。 这与最近的论点一致,即评价遗传性AI应作为衡量挑战对待,必须明确审查评价工具的目标构造和有效性[12、13]。

blocks.en: Although recent work has produced increasingly sophisticated protocols for improving and evaluating formal multi-step reasoning in LLMs, including mathematical reasoning through prompting, chain-of-thought variants, and self-reflection mechanisms [ 14 , 15 ] , analogous protocols for culturally situated reasoning remain less mature [ 16 ] . Emerging research on cultural awareness, cultural alignment, and cultural benchmarks has shown that multilingual competence does not imply cultural competence, and that LLMs remain brittle when reasoning about culture-specific knowledge, social norms, and situated meanings [ 17 , 18 , 19 ] .
blocks.zh: 虽然最近的工作已产生越来越复杂的协议来改进和评价法学硕士中正式的多步骤推理,包括通过催化的数学推理、思维的链式变体和自我反射机制[14、15],但文化定位推理的类似协议仍然不够成熟[16]。 有关文化意识、文化协调和文化基准的新兴研究表明,多语种能力并不意味着文化能力,在对文化特定知识、社会规范以及定位含义进行推理时,法学硕士仍然很简洁。

blocks.en: Evaluation practice itself is also changing. The LLM-as-a-judge paradigm has emerged as a scalable alternative for scoring, ranking, and selecting open-ended outputs, and has been shown to approximate human preferences reasonably well in some settings [ 20 ] . Yet judge models are not neutral evaluators: they can exhibit systematic biases, remain vulnerable to perturbations, and require careful reliability analysis and protocol design [ 21 , 22 ] . For this reason, LLM-based judgment is best treated not as a replacement for human grounding, but as one component within a broader evaluation framework. This motivates evaluation designs that combine human grounding with model-assisted assessment rather than relying exclusively on either source.
blocks.zh: 评价做法本身也在发生变化。 LLM-as-a-judge的范式已作为一种可扩展的可选方法出现,用于评分、排名和选择无限制产出,并显示在某些环境下,这种范式可以合理合理地接近人类喜好[20]。 然而,法官模型并不是中立的评估者:它们可能表现出系统性偏见,仍然容易受到干扰,需要认真的可靠性分析和协议设计[21、22]。 因此,基于LLM的判断最好不是作为人类地基的取而代之,而是作为更广泛的评价框架内的一个组成部分。 这促使评价设计将人的立足点与模型辅助评估相结合,而不是完全依赖两个来源。

blocks.en: In this paper, we build on these lines of work to study whether LLMs maintain culturally situated affective inferences when Spanish political language is humanly ambiguous or perturbed through counterfactual rewrites. We focus on Spanish social media discourse and move beyond conventional label-centric evaluation by combining three independent human annotation views with perturbation-based stress testing. Concretely, we construct a Gold subset from full annotator agreement, an Ambiguous subset from partial or complete annotator disagreement, and a Synthetic subset composed of sentiment-flipped counterfactuals generated from non-neutral posts. Synthetic instances retain the agreement condition of their source posts, allowing us to compare model behavior on original Gold and Ambiguous instances with counterfactual variants derived from them. We then compare GPT-4.1-mini, Llama3.1:8b, and DeepSeek-r1:8b under zero-shot and few-shot prompting, focusing on predictive robustness across human agreement conditions and counterfactual shift.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们在这些工作领域的基础上,研究在西班牙政治语言人文模糊或因反事实改写而扰动时,LLMs是否维持文化位置的感人推论。 我们关注西班牙社交媒体的言论, 具体地说,我们从完全的注释协议中构建出黄金子集,从部分或完全的注释者分歧中构建出一个模糊的子集,以及由非中立职位产生的情感扭曲反事实组成的合成子集。 合成实例保留了源站的约定条件,让我们可以将原始Gold和Amibvious实例上的模型行为与它们产生的反事实变体进行比较. 然后,我们将GPT-4.1-mini、Llama3.1:8b和DeepSeek-r1:8b在0-shot和数-shot-shot的提示下进行比较,重点是人类协议条件的预测强度和反事实转变。

blocks.en: Our contributions are threefold:
blocks.zh: 我们的贡献有三:

blocks.en: • We adapt and operationalize an evaluation protocol for Spanish political sentiment analysis that uses multi-annotator consensus, annotation ambiguity, and counterfactual perturbation as diagnostic conditions for assessing LLM robustness. • We empirically characterize robustness differences between proprietary and open-weight LLMs under zero-shot and few-shot prompting, showing how performance changes across Gold, Ambiguous, and Synthetic conditions. • We will release the human sentiment annotations, evaluation artifacts, and Spanish political discourse dataset.
blocks.zh: 二. 支助 我们为西班牙政治情绪分析调整并落实一项评价议定书,其中利用多注释者共识、注释模糊和反事实扰动作为评估LLM稳健性的诊断条件。 根据经验,我们在零镜头和几镜头提示下,将专有和开放式有限责任公司之间的强性差异定性为特征,表明Gold、Amiguy和合成条件的性能如何变化。 我们将发布人类情感说明、评估文物和西班牙政治言论数据集。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: This work is grounded in two complementary research lines. The first concerns reasoning-aware evaluation and model-assisted assessment of LLM outputs. Recent work has shown that evaluating LLMs is increasingly difficult because their outputs are open-ended, context-dependent, and not always well captured by single-task accuracy measures [ 1 ] . More broadly, natural language reasoning involves heterogeneous forms of inference over unstructured text, which makes evaluation especially challenging when tasks require more than surface-level pattern recognition [ 16 ] . In this context, the LLM-as-a-judge paradigm has emerged as a scalable mechanism for scoring, ranking, and selecting generated outputs. Zheng et al. [ 20 ] showed that strong LLM judges can approximate human preferences in conversational evaluation, making model-based assessment useful when human evaluation is costly. However, subsequent studies have emphasized that judge models are not neutral instruments. Chen et al. [ 21 ] show that both human and LLM judges may exhibit systematic biases, while Li et al. [ 22 ] discuss broader opportunities and limitations of using LLMs as evaluators. These findings motivate protocols in which model-assisted judgment may support candidate selection and diagnostic evaluation, but must remain constrained, documented, and grounded in human-annotated data.
blocks.zh: 这项工作以两个相辅相成的研究领域为基础。 第一个问题涉及对LLM产出进行理智评价和模型辅助评估。 最近的工作表明,评价有限责任项目越来越困难,因为其产出是无限制的、取决于具体情况的,并不总是能很好地被单一任务的准确度衡量[1]。 更广泛地说,自然语言推理涉及不同形式的推论,而不是非结构化文本,这使得在任务要求超出地表图案识别时评价尤其具有挑战性[16]. 在这方面,LLM-as-a-judge范式已经成为一种可扩展的机制,用于评分、排名和选择产生的产出。 郑等. [20] 显示强力LLM评委可以大致了解人对对话评价的偏好,使基于模型的评估在人的评价成本高时有用. 然而,后来的研究强调法官模型不是中立的工具. 陈等. [21] 显示人命和LLM法官都可能表现出系统性偏见,而Li等人则显示出这种偏见。 [22] 讨论将有限责任管理课程用作评价人员的更广泛机会和限制。 这些结果激发了协议的动力,在协议中,模型协助的判断可以支持候选人的甄选和诊断评价,但必须保持约束、记录和以人为附加说明的数据为基础。

blocks.en: The second line concerns cultural reasoning, cultural alignment, and politically sensitive language. Work on cultural alignment has shown that LLM behavior varies with prompting language, training mixtures, and cultural context [ 17 ] . Chiu et al. [ 18 ] further show that even strong models remain limited on diverse, human-authored cultural knowledge tasks, reinforcing Pawar et al.’s [ 19 ] view that cultural awareness requires more than multilingual capability, including sensitivity to social norms, values, and situated context. This gap is especially relevant because recent progress in LLM reasoning has focused heavily on mathematical or formal multi-step reasoning mechanisms [ 14 , 15 ] . By contrast, culturally situated reasoning remains less mature as an evaluation target, particularly when the task involves affective interpretation rather than factual cultural knowledge.
blocks.zh: 第二行涉及文化推理、文化协调以及政治敏感语言。 文化相协调方面的工作表明,LLM行为随激发语言,培训混合物和文化背景而异 [17].  Chi等. [18] 进一步表明,即使是强有力的模式也仍然局限于由人类授权的多种文化知识任务,这强化了帕瓦尔等人[19]的观点,即文化意识需要的不仅仅是多种语言的能力,包括对社会规范、价值观和位置背景的敏感性。 这一差距尤其相关,因为最近在LLM推理方面取得的进展在很大程度上侧重于数学或正式的多步骤推理机制[14,15]. 相比之下,文化背景的推理作为评价目标仍然不够成熟,特别是当任务涉及情感解释而不是实际的文化知识时。

blocks.en: Sentiment analysis in political discourse provides a concrete setting where these issues converge. As a well-established task for identifying opinions and affective orientation in text [ 8 ] , it has been widely applied to social media data for analyzing political behavior and electoral dynamics in Latin America [ 10 ] . In Spanish electoral social media, prior work has already introduced annotated resources and benchmarked pre-trained and large language models mainly through predictive sentiment performance [ 11 ] . The present paper takes this line of research in a different direction by shifting the emphasis from standard label prediction to robustness under annotator ambiguity and counterfactual perturbation. Methodologically, it builds on Ochieng et al. [ 13 ] , who argue that sentiment in culturally nuanced contexts should be evaluated beyond labels through ambiguity and counterfactual analysis. This use of counterfactual perturbation also connects to broader work on counterfactual reasoning and generation, where minimally altered rewrites are used to examine whether models preserve relevant invariances under controlled changes [ 23 ] . By adapting this perspective to Spanish political social media discourse, we position our work at the intersection of model-assisted evaluation and cultural reasoning, examining how ambiguity and counterfactual shifts affect predictive robustness in culturally situated sentiment classification.
blocks.zh: 政治讨论中的敏感性分析为这些问题的汇合提供了一个具体环境。 作为在文本 [8] 中确定意见和情感取向的既定任务,它被广泛应用于社交媒体数据,用于分析拉丁美洲的政治行为和选举动态[10]. 在西班牙选举社交媒体中,之前的工作已经引入了附加说明的资源,并主要通过预测情绪表现来基准化预训和大型语言模型[11]. 本文件将重点从标准标签预测转向在注释模糊和反事实扰动下稳健性,从而将这一研究线走向不同的方向。 在方法上,它以Ochieng等人为基础。 [13],他们认为,在文化上细微上下文的情绪应通过模糊不清和反事实分析来超越标签来评价. 这种对反事实扰动的使用也与反事实推理和生成的更广义的工作相联,后者使用最小变化的重写来检查模型是否在受控变化下保留了相关的偏差[23]. 通过将这一视角与西班牙政治社交媒体的言论相适应, 我们的工作定位在模型辅助评价和文化推理的交叉点,

blocks.en: 3 Evaluation Protocol
blocks.zh: 3. 评价议定书

blocks.en: This section describes the protocol used to transform a Spanish political sentiment corpus into a diagnostic evaluation setting for LLM robustness and culturally situated affective reasoning. The protocol treats human consensus, human ambiguity, and counterfactual shift as complementary evaluation conditions for assessing whether models go beyond label prediction and remain consistent under culturally and pragmatically sensitive variation.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍用于将西班牙政治情感体表转变为对LLM稳健性和文化定位的感性推理的诊断性评价环境的协议。 协议将人类共识、人类模糊和反事实转变视为评估模型是否超出标签预测范围的补充评价条件,并在文化和务实敏感差异下保持一致。

blocks.en: 3.1 Dataset and Human Annotation
blocks.zh: 3.1 数据集和人类注释

blocks.en: We use a Spanish political social media corpus collected between January 1 and July 31, 2024, from Facebook, Instagram, X, and YouTube, originally introduced by Valverde-Rebaza et al. [ 11 ] . The corpus contains posts related to the 2024 Mexican electoral process and was annotated independently by three native Spanish-speaking annotators using three sentiment categories: positive, negative, and neutral. In this paper, we use the resulting three-way annotation matrix as the basis for diagnostic evaluation, while the details of data collection, filtering, annotation guidelines, and inter-annotator agreement are provided in the original corpus description.
blocks.zh: 我们使用2024年1月1日至7月31日从Facebook、Instagram、X和YouTube收集的西班牙政治社交媒体, 书中包含与2024年墨西哥选举过程有关的职位,由三位讲西班牙语的本地注解者独立注释,使用三种情绪类别:正、负和中。 在本文中,我们使用由此产生的三向注释矩阵作为诊断评价的基础,而原始主体描述中则提供数据收集,过滤,注释指南和注释之间协议的细节.

In the table, POS, NEG, and NEU denote the consolidated sentiment labels; GOLD and AMBIGUOUS refer to the agreement-based subsets derived from the three human annotations; and SYNTHETIC denotes the non-neutral instances used for counterfactual generation.

blocks.en: When considering platform-level composition, X provides the largest subset, with 379 379 posts, followed by Instagram with 342 342 , Facebook with 338 338 , and YouTube with 295 295 . The sentiment composition varies substantially across platforms. Facebook is comparatively balanced, with 144 144 positive, 99 99 negative, and 95 95 neutral posts, whereas Instagram is skewed toward positive sentiment, with 193 193 positive posts against 52 52 negative and 97 97 neutral instances. X exhibits a sharply polarized profile toward negative sentiment, with 276 276 negative posts and a much smaller presence of 72 72 positive and 31 31 neutral instances. YouTube, in turn, is dominated by neutral content, with 214 214 neutral posts, 67 67 negative posts, and only 14 14 positive posts. These differences indicate that the corpus does not represent a homogeneous affective space across platforms. Accordingly, while platform-level variation is reported for transparency, the evaluation in this paper uses agreement structure and counterfactual perturbation as the primary diagnostic axes.
blocks.zh: 在考虑平台层面的构成时,X提供了最大的子集,有379 379个帖子,其次是Instagram有342 342个帖子,Facebook有338 338个帖子,YouTube有295 295个帖子. 不同平台的情绪构成差异很大。 Facebook相对平衡,144个正、99个正和95个中性文章,而Instagram则向正情绪倾斜,193个正、52个正和97个中性文章。 X显示出对负面情绪的两极分化,276 276起负面文章,72起正面事件和31起中性事件的规模要小得多。 而YouTube则以中性内容为主,有214个中性帖子,67个负面帖子,只有14个正性帖子. 这些差异表明,本文书并不代表跨平台的同质感空间。 因此,虽然报告平台层面的差异是为了提高透明度,但本文件中的评价使用协议结构和反事实扰动作为主要诊断轴。

blocks.en: Figure 1 complements Table 1 by visualizing the platform-level distribution of Gold and Ambiguous instances across sentiment categories. The figure shows that ambiguity is not uniformly distributed, with YouTube showing the highest proportion of ambiguous cases, whereas Facebook, Instagram, and X concentrate a larger share of Gold instances. This supports our use of agreement structure as a central diagnostic axis in the evaluation protocol.
blocks.zh: 图1 表1通过可视化地显示Gold和Ambigvious案例在情感类别之间的平台级别分布。 该图显示模糊性分布不统一,YouTube显示的模糊性案例比例最高,而Facebook,Instagram,和X则集中了Gold案例的较大份额. 这支持我们利用协议结构作为评价议定书中的核心诊断轴心。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Distribution of Gold and Ambiguous instances by platform and sentiment label. The Synthetic subset is constructed from non-neutral Gold and Ambiguous instances through sentiment-flipped counterfactuals.
blocks.zh: 图 1:通过平台和情绪标签传播黄金和模糊事例。 合成子集由非中性Gold和Amibvious通过情绪扭曲的反事实来构建.

blocks.en: 3.2 Gold and Ambiguous Subsets
blocks.zh: 3.2 黄金和含糊的子集

blocks.en: The three independent annotations associated with each post allow us to derive two agreement-based subsets, reported in Table 1 . The Gold subset includes posts for which the three annotators assigned the same sentiment label, representing cases of full human consensus. The Ambiguous subset includes all posts without full agreement, covering both partial agreement cases, in which two annotators selected the same label and one disagreed, and complete disagreement cases, in which the three annotators selected different labels.
blocks.zh: 与每个职位有关的三个独立说明使我们能够得出两个基于协议的子集,如表1所报告。 Gold子集包括三个注释者为这些职位分配了同样的情感标签,代表了人类充分共识的情况。 含糊不清的子集包括未经完全同意的所有员额,既包括部分协议案件,其中两名注释员选择同一标签,一名不同意,也包括完全分歧案件,其中三名注释员选择不同的标签。

blocks.en: Overall, the Gold subset contains 849 849 posts, corresponding to 62.7 % 62.7\% of the annotated corpus, while the Ambiguous subset contains 505 505 posts, corresponding to 37.3 % 37.3\% . At the platform level, Facebook includes 234 234 Gold and 104 104 Ambiguous posts, Instagram includes 220 220 Gold and 122 122 Ambiguous posts, X includes 253 253 Gold and 126 126 Ambiguous posts, and YouTube includes 142 142 Gold and 153 153 Ambiguous posts. As shown in Figure 1 , YouTube is the only platform where Ambiguous instances slightly exceed Gold instances, whereas Facebook, Instagram, and X show larger proportions of Gold cases.
blocks.zh: 总体来说,Gold子集包含849 849个员额,相当于说明书的62.7%,而Ambigacy子集包含505 505个员额,相当于37.3% 37.3%。 在平台层面,Facebook包括234 234 Gold和104 104 Ambigvious posts,Instagram包括220 220 Gold和122 122 Ambigvious posts,X包括253 253 Gold和126 126 Ambigvious posts,而YouTube包括142 142 Gold和153 Ambigvious posts. 如图1所显示,YouTube是唯一一个Ambigvious案例略高于Gold案例的平台,而Facebook、Instagram和X则显示Gold案例比例较大。

blocks.en: This partition is central to the evaluation protocol. Gold instances serve as the reference condition for cases in which sentiment interpretation is stable across human annotators. Ambiguous instances, in contrast, are treated as a diagnostic condition rather than as annotation noise. In political social media discourse, disagreement may reflect the presence of implicit stance, irony, platform-specific conventions, or context-dependent affective cues. For this reason, comparing model behavior across Gold and Ambiguous subsets allows us to evaluate whether LLMs remain robust when the sentiment signal is less explicit and less consistently interpreted by humans.
blocks.zh: 这个分区是评价协议的核心. 黄金案件是人类注释者情绪解释稳定的案例的参考条件。 与此相反,模糊不清的病例被视为诊断性情况,而不是注音。 在政治社交媒体的言论中,分歧可能反映存在隐含的立场,讽刺性,针对具体平台的公约,或取决于背景的感人提示. 因此,在Gold和Ambigacy子集的模型行为上进行比较,使我们能够评估在情绪信号不太明确、人类解释不够一致时,LLMs是否仍然强劲。

blocks.en: 3.3 Counterfactual Generation and Selection
blocks.zh: 3.3 反事实生成和选择

blocks.en: To evaluate robustness under controlled affective perturbation, we construct a Synthetic subset composed of sentiment-flipped counterfactuals. In line with reasoning-aware evaluation in culturally nuanced sentiment analysis [ 13 ] and broader work on counterfactual rewriting [ 23 ] , these counterfactuals are used to test whether models respond consistently when the affective orientation of a post is intentionally modified while its topic, informal style, and political context are preserved. Figure 2 summarizes the complete evaluation flow, distinguishing the direct classification path followed by Gold and Ambiguous instances from the counterfactual construction path followed by Synthetic instances.
blocks.zh: 为了评估在受控的有震动扰动下的稳健性,我们构建了一个由情绪扭曲反事实组成的合成子集. 根据在文化上细微的情感分析中的推理-感知评价[13]和关于反事实改写的更广泛工作[23],这些反事实被用来检验模型是否在某一职位的取向被有意修改而其主题、非正式风格和政治背景得到保留时一致地作出反应。 图2总结了完整的评价流程,区分了Gold和Ambigious案例所遵循的直接分类路径和Synthetic案例所遵循的反事实构建路径。

blocks.en: Counterfactual generation is applied only to non-neutral posts, since polarity inversion is directly defined for positive and negative instances but less straightforward for neutral content. As reported in Table 1 , the Synthetic subset is derived from 917 917 eligible source instances, corresponding to the 423 423 positive and 494 494 negative posts in the corpus. At the platform level, X contributes the largest number of eligible source posts, with 348 348 non-neutral instances, followed by Instagram with 245 245 , Facebook with 243 243 , and YouTube with 81 81 . This distribution reflects the sentiment profile of each platform, since X contributes many counterfactual sources due to its strong concentration of negative posts, whereas YouTube contributes fewer because most of its content is neutral.
blocks.zh: 反事实生成只适用于非中性站点,因为极性倒置直接被定义为正而负的情况,而中性内容则不那么直接. 如表1所报告,合成子集来自917 917个符合条件的来源案例,对应的是423 423个正数和494 494个负数。 在平台层面,X贡献了最多符合条件的源站点,有348个非中性事件348起,其次是Instagram245 245起;Facebook243 243起;YouTube81 81起。 这个分布反映了每个平台的情感概况,因为X因其负面文章的强烈集中而贡献了许多反事实来源,而YouTube贡献较少,因为其大部分内容都是中性的.

blocks.en: For each eligible post, the counterfactual construction process is model-conditioned. That is, for each model-specific run, the same LLM associated with that run is prompted to generate three alternative rewrites that invert the original sentiment. Although Figure 2 abstracts this step as counterfactual candidate generation, the generation itself is performed by the corresponding LLM under an explicit rewriting prompt. The transformation may involve changes in sentiment-bearing keywords, negation, tone, framing, emojis, hashtags, or sentence structure. The objective is not to generate unrestricted paraphrases, but to create plausible variants that alter the affective orientation while preserving the communicative setting of the original post. This model-conditioned design means that the Synthetic condition should be interpreted as an end-to-end diagnostic of each model’s ability to generate, select, and classify sentiment-flipped variants, rather than as an externally validated counterfactual benchmark.
blocks.zh: 对于每个符合条件的员额,反事实施工过程都是有模型条件的. 也就是说,对于每个模型特定运行来说,与该运行相关的相同的LLM会被催生出三个可替换的重写来颠倒原来的情绪. 虽然图2摘要了这一步骤作为反事实候选生成,但该生成本身由相应的LLM在明确的重写提示下进行. 这种转变可能涉及情绪关键词、否定语、语气、框架、emojis、标签或句子结构的变化。 目的不是产生不受限制的句子,而是创造可能变体,在保留原帖子的通俗设置的同时改变取向. 这种模型有条件的设计意味着合成条件应被解释为对每个模型生成,选择和分类情绪流出变体能力的端到端诊断,而不是外部验证的反事实基准.

blocks.en: The resulting candidates are then filtered through two complementary selection strategies. The first is based on perplexity and selects the candidate with the lowest model-based expectedness score, using perplexity as a proxy for linguistic plausibility within the corresponding model run. The second uses an LLM-as-a-judge criterion, where the same model-conditioned LLM selects the candidate that best preserves fluency, plausibility, contextual consistency, and clarity of the sentiment shift. Thus, although the figure presents this stage compactly as counterfactual selection, the judge-based selection stage is also model-assisted. These criteria are kept separate because they capture different aspects of counterfactual suitability: perplexity favors linguistically expected formulations, whereas the judge-based criterion prioritizes communicative adequacy and the explicitness of the affective inversion.
blocks.zh: 然后,通过两个互补的甄选战略筛选出候选人。 第一种是以迷惑为主,选取模型基于期望分数最低的候选人,在相应的模型跑道内以迷惑为语言可信度的代名词. 第二种标准采用LLM-as-a-judge标准,即同一模型条件的LLM选择最能保持流利,合理性,环境一致性,情绪转变清晰度的候选人. 因此,虽然该图将这一阶段紧凑地表述为反事实选择,但以法官为基础的选择阶段也是模型辅助的。 这些标准是分开的,因为它们捕捉到反事实适用性的不同方面:迷惑偏好语言上预期的提法,而以法官为基础的标准则优先考虑沟通的充分性和反感的明显性。

blocks.en: Figure 2: Experimental flow for evaluating cultural reasoning in political sentiment analysis. Gold and Ambiguous instances are classified using the original posts and evaluated against the original sentiment label, whereas Synthetic instances are first constructed through counterfactual generation and selection and then evaluated against the expected inverted sentiment.
blocks.zh: 图 2:在政治情绪分析中评价文化推理的实验流. Gold和Ambigvious案例使用原始帖子进行分类,并根据原始情绪标签进行评估,而合成案例首先通过反事实生成和选择来构建,然后根据预期的倒置情绪进行评估。

blocks.en: After selection, the chosen counterfactual becomes the input for the Synthetic classification condition. In this condition, the model does not classify the original post; instead, it classifies the selected counterfactual text, and the expected label is the inverted sentiment relative to the original non-neutral post. For example, a positive original post is expected to become negative after counterfactual rewriting, and a negative original post is expected to become positive. Synthetic instances also retain the agreement condition of their source posts. Thus, Synthetic-Gold refers to counterfactuals generated from non-neutral posts originally belonging to the Gold subset, whereas Synthetic-Ambiguous refers to counterfactuals generated from non-neutral posts originally belonging to the Ambiguous subset. This distinction allows us to compare model behavior on original posts and counterfactual variants while preserving the role of human agreement as a diagnostic axis.
blocks.zh: 选取后,所选取的反事实会成为合成分级条件的输入. 在此条件下,模型不将原帖子进行分类;取而代之的是,它将选定的反事实文本进行分类,预期的标签是相对于原非中性帖子的倒置情绪. 例如,一个正原员额预计在反事实重写后会变成负原员额,一个负原员额预计将变成正原员额. 合成实例也保留了其源员额的协议条件。 因此,Synthetic-Gold指的是原属于Gold子集的非中性站点所产生的反事实,而Synthetic-Ambigacy指的是原属于Ambigacy子集的非中性站点所产生的反事实. 这种区分使我们能够比较原始站点上的模型行为和反事实变体,同时保留人类协议作为诊断轴的作用.

blocks.en: 4 Experimental Setup
blocks.zh: 4 实验设置

blocks.en: This section describes how the proposed protocol was instantiated across models, prompting strategies, and evaluation metrics. The experiments compare model behavior over the Gold, Ambiguous, and Synthetic conditions, focusing on sentiment classification robustness under human agreement, annotator ambiguity, and counterfactual shift. In all conditions and as shown in Figure 2 , the target task remains sentiment prediction; what changes is the input type and the reference label used for evaluation. Gold and Ambiguous instances are classified using the original post and the consolidated sentiment label, whereas Synthetic instances are classified using the selected counterfactual text and the expected inverted sentiment label.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍拟议协议如何在模型、推动战略和评价指标之间进行即时分析。 实验比较了"黄金","安比克","合成条件"的模型行为,侧重于人类协议下的情绪分类稳健性,注释者模糊性,以及反事实转变. 在所有条件下,如图2所示,目标任务仍然是情绪预测;哪些变化是用于评价的输入类型和参考标签. Gold and Ambiguy 实例使用原始的帖子和合并的情绪标签进行分类,而合成实例则使用选定的反事实文本和预期的倒转情绪标签进行分类.

blocks.en: 4.1 Models
blocks.zh: 4.1 模式

blocks.en: We evaluate three LLMs selected to cover proprietary and open-weight deployment settings. GPT-4.1-mini is used as the proprietary reference model. Llama3.1:8b is included as an open-weight instruction-tuned model, providing a reproducible baseline for local deployment. DeepSeek-r1:8b is included as an open-weight reasoning-oriented model, allowing us to examine whether reasoning-specialized behavior is reflected in sentiment interpretation under ambiguity and counterfactual shift.
blocks.zh: 我们评估了为涵盖专有和开放重量部署设置而选定的3个有限责任公司。 GPT-4.1-mini被用作专有参考模型. Llama3.1:8b作为开放重量的指令调制模型列入,为当地部署提供了可复制的基线。 DeepSeek-r1:8b作为一个开放量级的以推理为取向的模型被包含在内,使我们能够检查推理-专门行为是否在模棱两可和反事实转变下的情绪解释中得到反映.

blocks.en: The comparison should be interpreted with attention to model scale and availability. Llama3.1:8b and DeepSeek-r1:8b are 8B-parameter models and therefore correspond to relatively small LLMs. By contrast, GPT-4.1-mini is a proprietary model whose exact parameter count is not publicly documented. Consequently, the experiments should not be read as a general comparison between proprietary and open-weight models, nor as representative of larger frontier models or larger open-weight alternatives. Rather, they compare three accessible models under the same robustness-oriented diagnostic protocol.
blocks.zh: 对比较的解释应注意模型规模和可用性。 Llama3.1:8b和DeepSeek-r1:8b是8B参数模型,因此对应相对较小的LLM. 相形之下,GPT-4.1-mini是一个专有模型,其确切参数计数没有公开记载. 因此,这些实验不应被理解为专利模型和开放重量模型之间的一般比较,也不应被理解为代表较大的前沿模型或更大的开放重量替代品。 相反,它们比较了在同样以强性为导向的诊断规程下三种可用的模型。

blocks.en: All models were evaluated under the same diagnostic protocol and label space. Sentiment labels were encoded as three mutually exclusive classes: negative , neutral , and positive . To reduce stochastic variation in classification and rubric-based scoring, temperature was set to 0.0 0.0 for sentiment prediction and explanation evaluation. For counterfactual generation, temperature was increased to 0.9 0.9 to encourage lexical and pragmatic diversity among candidate rewrites. Counterfactual selection was performed with a low-temperature setting to favor stable candidate choice.
blocks.zh: 所有模型都根据同样的诊断协议和标签空间进行了评估。 感官标签被编码为三个相互排斥的类别:负,中和正. 为了减少分类和以分数为基础的分数中的分数变化,温度被设定为0.00.0,用于情绪预测和解释评价. 对于反事实生成,温度被提高到0.9 0.9,以鼓励候选重写者之间的词汇和实用多样性. 反事实选择是在低温环境下进行的,有利于稳定的候选人选择。

blocks.en: 4.2 Prompting Settings
blocks.zh: 4.2 提示设置

blocks.en: We evaluate each model under zero-shot and few-shot prompting. In the zero-shot setting, the model receives the target post and the sentiment label definitions, without labeled examples. In the few-shot setting, the same classification instruction is augmented with labeled examples sampled from the annotated corpus. We use up to k = 3 k=3 examples per class with a fixed random seed, yielding a balanced demonstration set whenever sufficient examples are available. The same sampling procedure is applied across models to preserve comparability.
blocks.zh: 我们用零发和几发的提示来评估每个模型。 在零镜头设定中,模型接收了目标帖子和情绪标签定义,没有被标注的例子. 在几发的设定中,同样的分类指令还增加了标有标签的示例,取自注释书。 我们使用最多为k = 3克= 3个实例,每类有固定随机种子,只要有足够的实例,就产生一个均衡的演示集。 为了保持可比性,在模型中采用了同样的取样程序。

blocks.en: All classification prompts require a structured JSON response containing the predicted sentiment label, a confidence score from 0 0 to 5 5 , supporting keywords, and a brief explanation. In this paper, explanations are retained as part of the model output for traceability, but the quantitative analysis focuses on predictive robustness. This structured response format constrains the output to the predefined label space and reduces invalid or verbose generations.
blocks.zh: 所有分类提示都需要一个结构化的JSON响应,包含预测的情绪标签,信任分从0分到5分5分,支持关键词,以及一个简短的解释. 本文保留了解释作为可追溯性模型输出的一部分,但定量分析侧重于预测稳健性. 这种结构化的响应格式会将输出限制在预定义的标签空间上并减少无效或动词代代.

blocks.en: For the Synthetic condition, prompting is used in two additional stages already defined in Section 3.3 . First, the counterfactual generation prompt asks the model to produce three sentiment-flipped rewrites of each eligible non-neutral post while preserving topic, political context, informal tone, and plausibility. Second, the judge-based selection prompt asks the corresponding model-conditioned LLM to choose the candidate that most clearly and plausibly expresses the intended sentiment inversion. The perplexity-based selection condition does not require an additional prompt, since it ranks candidates through model-based expectedness rather than judgment instructions.
blocks.zh: 对于合成条件,在3.3节已经界定的两个额外阶段使用催化法。 首先,反事实生成提示要求模型在保留主题、政治背景、非正式基调和可信度的同时,对每个合格的非中立职位产生出三个感想的重写。 第二,基于法官的甄选即时要求相应的模型条件LLM选择最明确和最合理地表达意向情绪倒置的候选人. 基于复杂因素的甄选条件不需要额外的即时条件,因为它通过基于模型的预期而不是判断指示对候选人进行排名。

blocks.en: Table 2 summarizes the core instructions implemented in the prompt templates used in the experimental pipeline. The table reports functionally equivalent descriptions rather than verbatim prompts, while the complete raw templates will be released with the experimental artifacts.
blocks.zh: 表2汇总了实验管道所用即时模板中执行的核心指示。 该表报告功能等同的描述而不是逐字记录,而完整的原始模板将随实验文物一起发布。

blocks.en: 4.3 Metrics
blocks.zh: 4.3 计量

blocks.en: The evaluation metrics are aligned with the three diagnostic conditions defined in the protocol. For Gold and Ambiguous instances, the model prediction is compared against the consolidated sentiment label of the original post. For Synthetic instances, the model prediction is compared against the expected inverted label of the selected counterfactual. Thus, the classification task remains sentiment prediction in all cases, but the Synthetic condition evaluates whether the model recognizes the intended polarity shift introduced by the counterfactual rewrite.
blocks.zh: 评价指标与协议所定义的三个诊断条件相一致。 对于Gold和Ambigvious的例子,模型预测与原始文章的合并情绪标签相比较. 对于合成实例,模型预测与所选反事实的预期倒转标签进行比较. 因此,分类任务在所有情况下仍然是情绪预测,但合成条件评价模型是否承认了由反事实重写所引入的预期极性转移.

blocks.en: For sentiment prediction, we report F1-scores by class and evaluation condition. Results are computed separately for Gold, Ambiguous, and Synthetic subsets, allowing us to compare performance under full human agreement, annotator disagreement, and controlled sentiment shift. This separation is central to the experimental design because aggregate performance over the original corpus may obscure failures that emerge only when sentiment is ambiguous or deliberately perturbed.
blocks.zh: 关于情绪预测,我们按等级和评价条件报告F1-分数。 对Gold、Ambigoy和Synthetic子集的结果分别进行计算, 使我们能够比较人类完全同意的性能, 注释者分歧,以及控制情绪的转变。 这种分离是实验设计的核心,因为总体性能超过原始体,可能掩盖只有在情绪模糊或故意扰动时才出现的失败。

blocks.en: For the Synthetic condition, we also use two auxiliary diagnostics to interpret the counterfactual construction process. The flip rate measures whether the selected counterfactual changes the sentiment label relative to the original post. In this setting, a successful flip indicates that the rewritten text expresses the intended opposite polarity. We also compute token-level Levenshtein distance between the original post and the selected counterfactual, which estimates the magnitude of textual modification introduced by the rewrite. These measures are used as construction-level diagnostics, whereas the main comparative analysis is based on sentiment classification performance across models, prompting strategies, and evaluation conditions.
blocks.zh: 对于合成状态,我们也使用两个辅助诊断来解释反事实构造过程. 翻转速率衡量所选反事实是否相对于原帖改变情绪标签. 在此设置中,一个成功的翻转表示重写文本表达意图相反的极性. 我们还计算出原始帖子和所选反事实之间的符号级Levenshtein相距,这估计了重写时引入的文字修改的大小. 这些措施被用作建筑层面的诊断,而主要比较分析则基于各种模型的情绪分类表现、激励战略和评价条件。

blocks.en: 5 Results and Discussion
blocks.zh: 5 结果和讨论

blocks.en: This section reports the empirical results obtained under the proposed diagnostic protocol. We focus on three complementary views. First, we compare F1-scores across Gold, Ambiguous, and Synthetic conditions. Second, we contrast these results with a contextual reference derived from conventional original-corpus sentiment classification. Third, we analyze the drop in F1-score relative to the Original-Gold condition, which represents the clearest setting in terms of human agreement.

blocks.en: 5.4 Effect of Few-shot Prompting
blocks.zh: 5.4 少发子弹的影响

blocks.en: We also examine whether few-shot prompting mitigates the degradation observed under ambiguity and counterfactual shift. blocks.en: These results indicate that the main difficulty is not simply the absence of task examples or output-format guidance. If the errors were primarily due to prompt underspecification, few-shot prompting would be expected to produce more systematic improvements. Instead, the limited gains suggest that the performance loss is driven by the intrinsic difficulty of interpreting politically situated affective meaning under annotator ambiguity and controlled sentiment perturbation. This is also consistent with Figure 5 , where few-shot rows exhibit degradation patterns comparable to their zero-shot counterparts rather than a clear recovery toward the Original-Gold condition.
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,主要困难不仅仅是缺乏任务实例或产出格式指导。 如果错误主要是由于迅速的描述不足,那么预计很少镜头的提示会产生更系统的改进。 相反,有限的收益表明,性能损失是由在注释者含糊不清和控制情绪的干扰下解释政治位置的情感含义的固有困难所驱动的。 这与图5也是一致的,图5显示的低射行退化模式与零射行相似,而不是向原金状态明显恢复。

blocks.en: 5.5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5.5 限制

blocks.en: Our results should be interpreted within the scope of the proposed diagnostic design. First, the Synthetic condition was constructed through a model-assisted and model-conditioned pipeline. Counterfactual generation and judge-based selection may therefore introduce self-selection bias, since a model may select rewrites that are more compatible with its own generation style or easier for itself to classify. Consequently, the Synthetic-Judge results in Table 3 should be read as end-to-end diagnostic evidence of model behavior, rather than as externally validated evidence of counterfactual quality.
blocks.zh: 我们的结果应该在拟议的诊断设计的范围内加以解释。 首先,合成条件通过模型辅助和模型条件管道来构建. 因此,反事实生成和以法官为基础的选择可能引入自选偏好,因为一个模型可能选择更符合其自身生成风格或更容易自己分类的重写. 因此,表3中的合成-法官结果应被解读为模型行为的端到端诊断证据,而不是外部验证的反事实质量证据.

blocks.en: Second, the comparison between Synthetic-PPL and Synthetic-Judge partially mitigates this concern. The similar degradation patterns in Figure 5 suggest that the main robustness trends are not entirely dependent on a single selection criterion. Nevertheless, neither perplexity-based selection nor LLM-as-a-judge selection replaces human validation. Accordingly, this study does not make claims about counterfactual quality in terms of fluency, naturalness, meaning preservation, or clarity of sentiment inversion, since these dimensions were not systematically assessed.
blocks.zh: 第二,合成人-人民党和合成人-法官之间的比较部分地减轻了这一关切。 图5中的类似退化模式表明,主要强性趋势并不完全取决于单一的选择标准。 尽管如此,基于迷惑性的选择和作为法官的LLM的选择都不能取代人类验证。 因此,本研究没有从流利性、自然性、意思是保护或情绪倒置的明确性等方面对反事实质量提出主张,因为这些方面没有得到系统的评估。

blocks.en: Third, the scope of the evaluated models and experimental settings is limited. The study compares three relatively small LLMs under zero-shot and few-shot prompting, without larger frontier models, fine-tuned supervised baselines, or sentiment-specific models trained on the target domain. Thus, the observed degradation patterns should not be interpreted as definitive evidence about all LLMs or about open-weight models in general. Differences among GPT-4.1-mini, DeepSeek-r1:8b, and Llama3.1:8b may reflect interacting factors such as model scale, instruction tuning, multilingual coverage, training data composition, and alignment strategy.
blocks.zh: 第三,评价模型和实验设置的范围有限。 研究比较了3个相对较小的LLMs在零发和少发的提示下,没有更大的前沿模型,微调的有监督的基线,或者在目标领域训练的有感情的特有模型. 因此,所观察到的退化模式不应被解释为所有有限责任公司或一般的开放式模型的确凿证据。 GPT-4.1-mini、DeepSeek-r1:8b和Llama3.1:8b之间的差异可能反映互动因素,如模型尺度、教学调制、多语种覆盖、培训数据组成和调整战略。

blocks.en: Finally, the analysis does not model platform-specific behavior beyond descriptive corpus statistics. Although Table 1 shows substantial variation across Facebook, Instagram, X, and YouTube, the evaluation treats agreement condition and counterfactual perturbation as the primary diagnostic axes. Platform-aware modeling is therefore left for future work. Similarly, model explanations were retained for traceability, but explanation quality was not evaluated as a main empirical axis.
blocks.zh: 最后,分析除了描述性实体统计外,没有模拟特定平台的行为。 虽然表1显示Facebook、Instagram、X和YouTube之间差异很大,但评价将协议条件和反事实扰动作为主要诊断轴。 因此,认识平台的建模工作留待今后进行。 同样,为可追踪性保留了示范解释,但解释的质量没有被评价为主要的经验轴.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: This paper evaluated LLM robustness for Spanish political sentiment analysis through a diagnostic protocol that goes beyond conventional original-corpus classification. Rather than treating sentiment prediction as a single aggregate task, we reorganized evaluation around three conditions: Gold instances with full human agreement, Ambiguous instances with annotator disagreement, and Synthetic instances generated through sentiment-flipped counterfactual perturbation. The results show that conventional sentiment classification can provide an incomplete picture of model reliability. In the Gold subset, the models achieved comparatively strong F1-scores, with GPT-4.1-mini exceeding the contextual conventional reference derived from prior platform-based evaluation. However, performance decreased substantially when the same task was evaluated under human ambiguity and counterfactual shift. This indicates that high performance on standard sentiment benchmarks does not necessarily imply robustness when affective meaning is culturally situated, pragmatically indirect, or unstable even among human annotators.
blocks.zh: 本文评价了LLM的稳健性,以通过超越常规原生-子公司分类的诊断协议进行西班牙政治情绪分析. 我们没有将情绪预测作为一个单一的总任务,而是围绕以下三个条件对评价进行了重组: 有人类充分认同的黄金案例,有注释者意见不一的模糊案例,以及通过情绪扭曲反事实扰动产生的合成案例。 结果显示,传统情绪分类可以提供模型可靠性的不完整图景. 在"黄金子集"中,模型实现了相对强大的F1-分数,GPT-4-mini超过了之前基于平台的评价得出的上下文常规参考. 然而,如果在人为模糊和反事实转移的情况下评价同一任务,业绩就会大大下降。 这表明,在标准情绪基准方面的高绩效并不一定意味着在情感含义具有文化位置、务实间接性或不稳定性时,即使是在人类的注释者中。

blocks.en: The main empirical finding is that annotator ambiguity and counterfactual perturbation expose different forms of model fragility. Ambiguous instances produced systematic drops across all models, suggesting that human disagreement is a meaningful signal of interpretive difficulty rather than merely annotation noise. Synthetic instances further revealed robustness gaps that were especially pronounced for the open-weight models. GPT-4.1-mini remained the most stable model across conditions, although it also degraded outside the Gold setting. DeepSeek-r1:8b and Llama3.1:8b performed reasonably on clear original instances but showed stronger degradation under counterfactual shift. These results suggest that politically situated sentiment analysis in Spanish requires evaluation protocols that explicitly account for disagreement, perturbation, and contextual affective cues.
blocks.zh: 主要的经验结论是,注释者模糊和反事实扰动暴露出不同形式的模型脆弱性. 模糊的事例在所有模型中产生了系统性的下降,表明人类的分歧是解释困难的一个有意义的信号,而不仅仅是注释噪音。 合成实例进一步表明,开放量模型存在强烈差距,尤其明显。 GPT-4.1-mini仍然是各种条件下最稳定的模型,尽管它也在黄金环境之外退化. DeepSeek-r1:8b和Llama3.1:8b在清晰的原始实例上表现合理,但在反事实转变下表现出更强的降解. 这些结果显示,西班牙语的政治情绪分析需要评价协议,明确说明分歧、扰动和背景感动提示。

blocks.en: The comparison with conventional sentiment classification is central to the contribution of this work. Standard evaluations organized by platform or aggregate performance remain valuable for benchmarking models under ordinary classification conditions. However, they do not fully address whether models preserve sentiment interpretation when language becomes ambiguous or when sentiment is intentionally inverted while preserving topic and political context. Our results therefore do not replace conventional sentiment analysis; rather, they complement it by showing where conventional evaluation may overestimate robustness. This distinction is particularly important for political discourse, where sentiment is often expressed through irony, emojis, hashtags, local references, implicit stance, and platform-specific communicative conventions.
blocks.zh: 与传统情绪分类的比较对这项工作的贡献至关重要。 按平台或总体业绩组织的标准评价,对于在普通分类条件下制定基准的模型仍然很有价值。 然而,它们并未充分述及模式在语言变得模糊时是否保留情绪解释,或在保留专题和政治背景时有意颠倒情绪。 因此,我们的结果不能取代传统情绪分析;相反,它们通过显示传统评价可能高估强性之处来补充这种分析。 这种区分对政治言论尤为重要,因为政治言论往往通过讽刺、情感、标签、地方参考、隐含立场和针对具体平台的宣传公约表达情绪。

blocks.en: This study has several limitations. First, the Synthetic condition was constructed through a model-assisted counterfactual pipeline, and therefore should be interpreted as a diagnostic stress condition rather than as a fully independent human-authored benchmark. Second, although counterfactual generation and selection were supported by perplexity and LLM-as-a-judge criteria, the present paper does not provide a full human validation of counterfactual quality. Third, we retained model explanations as part of the structured output, but we did not include explanation quality as a main empirical axis in this version of the paper. A more rigorous analysis of explanation faithfulness, contextual adequacy, and reasoning consistency remains necessary before making stronger claims about explanatory robustness. Fourth, the analysis did not model platform-specific behavior beyond reporting corpus composition, even though the distribution of sentiment and ambiguity differs across Facebook, Instagram, X, and YouTube. Finally, the study is limited to three LLMs and does not include a broader family of multilingual, sentiment-specific, or instruction-tuned models.
blocks.zh: 这项研究有一些局限性。 首先,合成条件是通过模型辅助反事实管道构建的,因此应当被解释为诊断性应激条件,而不是完全独立的人类授权基准. 第二,虽然反事实生成和选择得到了迷惑性和LLM-as-a-judge标准的支持,但本文件并没有为反事实质量提供全面的人类验证。 第三,我们保留了模型解释,作为结构化产出的一部分,但我们没有将解释质量列为本文的主要经验轴. 在对解释的可靠性提出更强烈的主张之前,仍需要更严格地分析解释的可靠性、内在性和推理的一致性。 尽管脸书、Instagram、X和YouTube的情绪和模糊性分布不同, 最后,该研究仅限于三个LLM,没有包括更广泛的多语种、情感特异性或教学调整模式。

blocks.en: Future work should address these limitations in four directions. First, the counterfactual subset should be strengthened through human validation, including judgments of fluency, naturalness, meaning preservation, and clarity of sentiment inversion. Second, explanation quality should be evaluated systematically, ideally combining human assessment with constrained model-assisted rubrics. Third, the protocol should be extended to platform-aware analysis, examining whether models behave differently across social media environments with distinct linguistic, demographic, and interactional patterns. Fourth, future experiments should include additional affective dimensions beyond polarity, such as emotion, sarcasm, aggressiveness, polarization, uncertainty, and stance. These extensions would allow a more complete characterization of political affect in Spanish social media discourse.
blocks.zh: 今后的工作应在四个方面解决这些局限性。 首先,反事实子集应该通过人类验证得到加强,包括判断流畅,自然,意思保存,以及情绪倒置的清晰度. 第二,应系统地评价解释的质量,最好把人类评估与有限的模型辅助主题结合起来。 第三,协议应扩大到平台意识分析,审查模型在语言、人口和互动模式不同的社交媒体环境中的表现是否不同。 第四,未来的实验应该包括超越极性的额外感官维度,如情感,讽刺,攻击性,分化,不确定性,和姿态等. 这些扩展将使西班牙社交媒体言论中对政治影响的描述更加完整.

blocks.en: Overall, this work contributes to the study of natural language reasoning in Spanish by showing that sentiment analysis becomes substantially more demanding when evaluated through human ambiguity and controlled counterfactual shift. The proposed protocol provides a practical way to examine whether LLMs merely assign labels or whether they remain stable when affective meaning depends on culturally and pragmatically situated cues. In doing so, it also contributes to a better understanding of Spanish-language social platforms as complex spaces of political expression, where sentiment cannot always be reduced to surface polarity. The dataset annotations, evaluation artifacts, and supporting materials are publicly available in the repository: https://github.com/jvalverr/sentimex-llm-benchmark/tree/main/cultural_reasoning .
blocks.zh: 总体而言,这项工作有助于研究西班牙语中的自然语言推理,表明在通过人文模糊和受控反事实转变来评估时,情绪分析要求要高得多。 拟议的议定书提供了一个切实可行的方法,用以审查LLMS是否仅仅指定了标签,或者当影响意义取决于文化和实际定位提示时这些标签是否保持稳定。 通过这样做,它也有助于人们更好地理解西班牙语社会平台是复杂的政治表达空间,在这里情绪不能总是被降低为地表极性. 数据集说明、评价文物和辅助材料可在以下资料库公开查阅:https://github.com/jvalverr/sentimex-llm-benchmark/tree/main/cultural_deasoning。
